# Prelim

> Prelim is the AI-powered talent assessment platform for enterprise hiring teams. It builds assessments from job descriptions, runs proctored adaptive tests, auto-scores every response, and returns a ranked, explainable shortlist — covering technical, leadership, and non-IT roles on one defensible scoring model.

## Product

- [Platform](https://prelim.io/platform/): How Prelim works — AI Test Builder, adaptive testing, auto-scoring, ranked shortlist
- [Products](https://prelim.io/products/): Full product suite — technical tests, leadership psychometrics, live coding IDE, anti-cheat, analytics, API
- [Pricing](https://prelim.io/pricing/): Free (100 assessments/month), Team (unlimited + live coding IDE), Enterprise (SSO, SOC 2, on-prem)

## Solutions

- [Technical Hiring](https://prelim.io/solutions/technical-hiring/): Live coding IDE, system-design challenges, AI-scored responses for engineering roles
- [Leadership Hiring](https://prelim.io/solutions/leadership-hiring/): Situational judgment, psychometrics, 360° input for executives and managers
- [Non-IT Hiring](https://prelim.io/solutions/non-it-hiring/): Role-specific batteries for finance, sales, operations, healthcare, and legal

## Industries

- [Industries](https://prelim.io/industries/): Technology, financial services, healthcare, legal, manufacturing, retail, BPO

- [About](https://prelim.io/about/): Prelim's mission — defensible hiring on evidence, not instinct
- [Security](https://prelim.io/security/): SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, flexible cloud/VPC/on-prem deployment
